The '''1956 DDR-Oberliga''' was the eighth season of the [[DDR-Oberliga]], the first tier of [[East German football league system|league football]] in [[East Germany]]. Rather than in the traditional autumn-spring format the Oberliga played for six seasons from 1955 to 1960 in the calendar year format, modelled on the system used in the [[Soviet Union]]. From 1961–62 onwards the league returned to its traditional format.

The league was contested by fourteen teams. [[FC Erzgebirge Aue|SC Wismut Karl-Marx-Stadt]], incidentally based at [[Aue, Saxony|Aue]] and not [[Chemnitz|Karl-Marx-Stadt]], won the championship, the club's first official one, having previously won the transition competition in 1955.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/ddrchamp.html |title= East Germany - List of Champions |website= [[RSSSF]] |access-date= 19 January 2016}}</ref><ref name="Meister" >{{cite web |url=https://www.dfb.de/historie/ddr-fussball/meister/ |title= DDR-Meister |website=dfb.de |publisher=[[German Football Association]] |access-date= 19 January 2016|language=de|trans-title= East German champions}}</ref> On the strength of this title Wismut qualified for the [[1957–58 European Cup]] where the club lost to [[Ajax Amsterdam]] in the first round.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/ec/ec195758.html |title= European Competitions 1957-58 |website= [[RSSSF]] |access-date= 19 January 2016}}</ref>

[[Ernst Lindner]] of [[Lok Stendal|BSG Lokomotive Stendal]] was the league's top scorer with 18 goals.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.weltfussball.de/torschuetzenkoenige/gdr-oberliga/ |title= DDDR » Oberliga » Torschützenkönige  |website= Weltfussball.de |access-date= 19 January 2016|language=de|trans-title=DDR-Oberliga top scorers }}</ref>

==Table==									
The 1956 season saw two newly promoted clubs compare to the last official season, 1954–55, [[Fortschritt Weißenfels]] and [[Lok Stendal|BSG Lokomotive Stendal]], with both already having played in the transition round in 1955. The [[FDGB-Pokal]] was won by second division [[DDR-Liga]] club [[Chemie Halle]].<ref name="Ddr" >{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/ddrhist.html |title= East Germany 1946-1990 |website= [[RSSSF]] |access-date= 19 January 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.weltfussball.de/spielplan/gdr-oberliga-1956-spieltag/26/ |title= DDR » Oberliga 1956 |website= Weltfussball.de |access-date= 19 January 2016|language=de|trans-title=DDR-Oberliga 1956}}</ref>
